title: Binding Policy
description: Agreement-time constraint on a flexible (to_be_bound) slot. Emitted by the translator into slot capability.json (covered by capabilityHash). See docs/binding/TRUST_LATE_BINDING_CONTRACT.md.

mode.description: Present only for a late-bound slot; a fixed participant carries no binding object.

authorizedBinder.description: Org permitted to bind this slot (defaults to the participant's org).

runtimes.description: Allowed runtime/backend families (the allow-list a binding is checked against). Vocabulary intentionally open in v1; empties rejected.

minAssurance.description: Minimum assurance tier a binding must meet. Optional.

evidenceProfile.description: RESERVED (not yet emitted): required runtime-evidence profile a binding must produce.

rebinding.description: RESERVED (not yet emitted): whether/how a bound slot may be rebound.

compliance.description: RESERVED (not yet emitted): data-residency / compliance tier constraints.
